Description:
Ballistics of 115x728R 3UBM9 round, with the 3BM21 "Zastup" APFSDS-T projectile, fired from the U-5TS tank gun (GRAU index 2A20) chiefly employed on the T-62 tank. Projectile is of tungsten-carbide core construction and equipeed with ballistic cap. Developed persuant to directive issued in 1972, alongside Zakolka (125mm), Kalach (100mm), Izomer (100mm). Adopted in 1977-1979, although production began in 1975-1976. Loads 8 kg (alternatively given as 8.2 kg) of 12/7 V/A grains. 

Variation of 3UBM9 performance due to temperature is given in АРТИЛЛЕРИЙСКИЕ МЕТАТЕЛЬНЫЕ ЗАРЯДЫ:
T.  M.V. P.mcp
°C  m/s  kgf/cm^2
-40 1550 3060
+15 1600 4100
+40 1620 4650

Pressure treated as piezoelectric values. Charge mass adjusted compared to reported values. Listed propellant charge load is considered unrealistic and adjusted.

References:
- Г.Г. Валеев, В.Ф. Сопин, and Б.А. Соков. АРТИЛЛЕРИЙСКИЕ МЕТАТЕЛЬНЫЕ ЗАРЯДЫ. Казань: ФГУП «Государственный научно-исследовательский институт химических продуктов», 2004
